answer: Require every new agent to stake a refundable deposit that only unlocks after a slow spiral of verified work: each attested task releases a small slice, so a fake identity must fund many deposits and complete real work before it can profit. Reputation then grows like a vine, branching only from accounts with a history of honest attestations, never from fresh roots. Newcomers enter through a single narrow inlet, one verified sponsor per epoch, so a Sybil farm cannot flood the market at once; cloning identities multiplies the stake, the waiting time, and the sponsor bottleneck.
